# Beer365

> Beer365 is beer intelligence for the whole beer business, built by Disruptive Advantage on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric inside the brewery's own tenant. It joins brewhouse, cellar, packaging, quality, supply chain, sales and finance data into one batch record, with dashboards, a digital twin and a generative AI copilot whose answers cite the batch and tag they came from.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/): what Beer365 does, how savings are counted and proved
- [Every question Beer365 answers](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/use-cases.html): 221 brewery use cases by area
- [Calculator](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/roi.html): brewhouse savings from your own figures
- [Pricing](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/pricing.html)
- [Contact](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/contact.html)

## Guides
- [Where AI in brewing earns its keep across the whole brewery](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-ai-in-brewing.html): AI in brewing, department by department: where machine learning and GenAI pay back in a brewery, the data each needs and the traps that make it lie.
- [The beer data your brewery already has and does not use](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-beer-data-you-already-have.html): The beer data a brewery already has: brew sheets, lab, historian, ERP, excise and sales records, what each one answers and how to join them by batch.
- [How to approach brewery data and AI on AWS if you already run there](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-on-aws.html): Brewery data and AI on AWS: S3, AWS IoT SiteWise and Amazon Bedrock for a brewery, plus how Microsoft Fabric reads the same S3 data without copying it.
- [How to approach brewery data and AI on Google Cloud](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-on-google-cloud.html): Brewery data and AI on Google Cloud (GCP): BigQuery, BigQuery ML and grounded GenAI for breweries, plus how Microsoft Fabric reads it without a migration.
- [Building a brewery data platform on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-platform-azure-fabric.html): How to build a brewery data platform on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric: ERP, historian, lab and sales data in OneLake, one batch record, secured.
- [Brewery data strategy, a staged plan for where to start](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-strategy.html): A brewery data strategy in stages: which question to start with, how to build one batch record and when dashboards, ML and GenAI earn their place.
- [What a brewery digital twin is and what it is not](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-digital-twin.html): What a brewery digital twin is and is not: a live model of tanks, lines and batches fed by plant data, not a 3D render with no data behind it.
- [Generative AI for breweries, grounded in batch records with citations](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-generative-ai-for-breweries.html): Generative AI for breweries: how a GenAI copilot grounded in batch records answers with citations, plus where it should never be used on the brewery floor.
- [The Power BI dashboards a brewery actually needs, role by role](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-power-bi-for-breweries.html): Power BI for breweries by role: the dashboards head brewers, packaging, quality, supply chain, sales and finance use, with the measures behind them.
- [Predictive maintenance in a brewery, from compressors to fillers](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-predictive-maintenance-brewery.html): Predictive maintenance for breweries: where machine learning helps on pumps, ammonia compressors and fillers, the data it needs and the traps to avoid.

## White papers and business cases
- [Brewery business cases: what one batch record is worth at four sizes](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/whitepaper-brewery-business-cases.html): Modelled brewery business cases at four sizes: beer loss, extract, energy, dumped batches and reporting savings, with assumptions and a conservative case. PDF: https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/brewery-business-cases.pdf
- [How beer AI vendors prove value, and how to test the claim](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/whitepaper-how-beer-ai-vendors-prove-value.html): How 116 beer AI companies justify savings claims: who publishes prices, methods and guarantees, plus ten questions to ask any vendor before you sign. PDF: https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/how-beer-ai-vendors-prove-value.pdf
- [The state of AI and data in beer, 2026](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/whitepaper-state-of-beer-ai-2026.html): 276 beer companies in an open dataset, counted by AI maturity, theme and country: where AI is shipping, where it is hype and where the gaps are. PDF: https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/state-of-beer-ai-2026.pdf
